description: This file defines an interface class IIpcFactory for creating IPC server components related to application management, session management, and control services within the Rialto server IPC namespace.

classes.name: IIpcFactory
classes.description: An interface class for creating various IPC server components related to application management and session management services.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IApplicationManagementServer, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionManagementServer, given playback, cdm, and control services.
